2. A mapped node over three photos asks three approvals.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a10_approval_scoped_per_element]
statements:
```text
send(node) AND class IN {state-transition, external-effect, destructive}
-> (approval.status = approved AND approval.unused AND request_digest(send) = approval.request_digest)
   OR (grant.active AND grant.flow_version = run.flow_version AND class != destructive
       AND NOT resend_after_not_applied)
approval_used_at_most_once
no_decision -/> state_change
decider(approval | grant | revoke) = owner
```

verdicts.item:
2. A mapped node over three photos asks three approvals.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a10_approval_scoped_per_element]
statements:
```text
send(node) AND class IN {state-transition, external-effect, destructive}
-> (approval.status = approved AND approval.unused AND request_digest(send) = approval.request_digest)
   OR (grant.active AND grant.flow_version = run.flow_version AND class != destructive
       AND NOT resend_after_not_applied)
approval_used_at_most_once
no_decision -/> state_change
decider(approval | grant | revoke) = owner
```
quotes: assert sorted(a.map_index for a in approvals) == [0, 1, 2]
assert all(a.node_id == "send" for a in approvals)
assert all(_v(a.status) == "requested" for a in approvals)
assert len({a.approval_id for a in approvals}) == 3
assert len({a.request_digest for a in approvals}) == 3
verdicts.why: The test asserts three distinct per-element approvals, no send before a decision, and that approving one element uses only its approval and sends only that element. It does not assert request-digest equality for the actual send, grant/version/destructive/resend rules, owner-only decision authority, or the general no-decision state-change rule.
